description: Branch-only boundary fix. Functional/files: add an explicit Engine domain action for actor-bound AI runtime credential resolution/config projection; migrate Zaq.Agent.Factory branch-added Connect.resolve_credential and direct AI credential read to NodeRouter dispatch. Preserve selected personal/global policy, no fallback after selected failure, OAuth refresh, owner provenance and ephemeral authentication. Event must be confidential and actor must come from trusted execution context; no generic :invoke and no public secret persistence/logging/broadcast. Tests first: Engine API action request/actor validation, confidential routing, local/remote response contract, missing/invalid actor, personal/global selection and secret-redaction metadata; Factory proves no direct Engine module default. Mock only NodeRouter boundary. Docs: Agent/System/Engine credential runtime contract. Action reuse: EXTEND Engine.Api and existing Connect resolver/System association rather than duplicate selection; new domain action is required because no existing action exposes this privileged operation safely.
title: [zaq-jrg.51] Add confidential Engine runtime credential resolution action
